description: Émissions de CO2e - périmètre complet is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Émissions de CO2e (kgCO2e/voyageur) sur les principales liaisons TGV, Intercités, TER et internationales (périmètre complet). Le périmètre complet du calcul des émissions de CO2e se définit comme la comptabilisation des émissions du périmètre de l'usage, c'est-à-dire les émissions produites lors de l'utilisation du véhicule (consommation de carburant ou d'électricité), auxquelles on ajoute les émissions produites ... Coverage: France. The portal files it under Développement durable. Its keywords are Développement durable, CO2, Environnement, Pollution, TGV, Intercités. The portal shows 2025-12-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
